categories.label: Conflict
categories.description: Interpersonal friction — with peers, managers, or across teams — and how you worked through it.
joggerPrompts: Think of a time two people on your team wanted different things and you had to referee it.
A disagreement that got tense before it got resolved.
A time you had to keep working closely with someone whose style clashed with yours.

categories.label: Failure
categories.description: Mistakes, missed calls, and things that went wrong — and what you did after.
joggerPrompts: A project that shipped late, broke in production, or got cancelled.
A decision you made that you would take back if you could.
A time you had to tell your manager something went wrong.

categories.label: Leadership
categories.description: Driving outcomes, developing people, or setting direction — with or without formal authority.
joggerPrompts: A time you influenced people without having authority over them.
Onboarding, mentoring, or unblocking a teammate.
A time you made the call when no one else would step up.

categories.label: Ambiguity
categories.description: Operating without a clear spec, changing requirements, or no existing playbook.
joggerPrompts: A project that started with a vague, one-line ask.
A time requirements changed mid-project and you had to adapt.
Something you had to build with no precedent to copy from.

categories.label: Delivery & Deadlines
categories.description: Shipping under time pressure, cutting scope, and recovering when behind schedule.
joggerPrompts: A deadline you almost missed and how you saved it.
A time you had to cut scope to ship on time.
Working late nights or weekends to hit a launch.

categories.label: Disagreement
categories.description: Pushing back on a plan, a manager, or a peer — and what happened after.
joggerPrompts: A time you disagreed with your manager's decision.
Pushing back on a plan you thought was wrong.
A time you lost the argument but executed anyway.

categories.label: Growth & Feedback
categories.description: Receiving and giving feedback, and closing skill gaps.
joggerPrompts: Tough feedback you received and what you did with it.
A skill gap you identified in yourself and closed.
A time a mentor changed how you work.

categories.label: Cross-Team Collaboration
categories.description: Working with, depending on, or influencing teams outside your own.
joggerPrompts: A project that needed two or more teams to agree before it could move.
Getting buy-in from a team that didn't report to you.
A dependency on another team that put your deadline at risk.

categories.label: Customer Focus
categories.description: Advocating for the user, even against internal pressure or convenience.
joggerPrompts: A time you advocated for the user against internal pressure.
A customer complaint that changed your roadmap.
A time 'good enough for the business' wasn't good enough for the user.

categories.label: Innovation
categories.description: Simplifying, automating, or proposing an approach nobody asked for.
joggerPrompts: A process you automated or simplified.
An unconventional solution you proposed that others were skeptical of.
A time you challenged 'that's how we've always done it.'
